realm_description: The coastline where continents first meet the wider world. Every citizen's story starts here, pulled outward by trade, curiosity, and the promise of connection.

primary.label: Explorer
primary.description: Fears limitation more than the unknown; needs to discover.
primary.guiding_promise: I will go where no map exists and make my own path.
primary.shadow_description: Never stays anywhere long enough to build something that could have lasted.

secondary.label: Pathfinder
secondary.description: Pioneers toward new worlds; rejects comfort as a destination.
secondary.guiding_promise: I reject comfort as a destination — the frontier is where I belong.
secondary.shadow_description: Pushes so far past the frontier that no one is left who remembers why they went.

wheel.central_question: Should we build a home, or discover a new one?

growth.label: Pathfinder
growth.description: Pioneers toward new worlds; rejects comfort as a destination.
growth.guiding_promise: I reject comfort as a destination — the frontier is where I belong.
growth.shadow_description: Pushes so far past the frontier that no one is left who remembers why they went.

other_ally.label: Navigator
other_ally.description: Reads currents no one else notices; calculates the way through when the group panics.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will find the true course, even when the stars are hidden.
other_ally.shadow_description: Trusts only their own reading of the current, and stops listening for anyone else's.

quarter.label: Bureaucrat
quarter.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
quarter.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
quarter.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

opposite.label: Architect
opposite.description: Designs systems meant to outlast the person who built them.
opposite.guiding_promise: I design what outlasts me — and that is enough.
opposite.shadow_description: Falls in love with the design and forgets the people who have to live inside it.

realmmate.label: Diplomat
realmmate.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
realmmate.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

wheel.compatible_text: Diplomat · Messenger — fellow travelers of The Shoreline.
